title: Clockwork Sanctuary: The Herbalist's Meridian Key
premise: In an overgrown observatory driven by silent brass escapements, the herbalist must isolate the cure from hazardous blooms using a woven specimen satchel.
ending: Recover the Meridian Key and return with the restorative field formula; Custodians of Dawn can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive charged gearfall while evading the watchmaker automaton without sacrificing the restorative field formula.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Custodians of Dawn to witness the woven specimen satchel.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to harvest a rare living specimen
